sources.snippet: Boogu-Image-0.1 is released for research purposes and is not intended for production deployment without additional safeguards. We took responsible-AI considerations into account during data curation, training, and evaluation; however the model may still produce outputs that are inaccurate, biased, or otherwise inappropriate.
